item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The world of metals and non-metals
item.stem: Meena's father wants to replace the old electrical wiring in their house in Jaipur. He asks Meena which property a metal must have so that it can be drawn into thin wires for the wiring. Which property should Meena name?

options.A: Ductility — copper and aluminium can be drawn into wires, so they are suitable
options.B: Shininess — any shiny material, even shiny coal, can be drawn into wires
options.C: Hardness — any hard solid can be made into wire if enough force is used
options.D: Brittleness — sulfur can be drawn into wires because it breaks easily
